_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Motherson Sumi Wiring India (standalone; no subsidiaries; Rs crore). One business (wiring harnesses and harness components for Indian vehicle makers), so revenue grows at a single rate and EBITDA margin is a driver; the business-line build (existing plants vs the three greenfields) is kept in lineBuild and checked against model revenue in MSUMI.ctx.js. Valued on P/E, as the street does.
_revenueWhy: FY27: Q1 revenue Rs3,407 cr (+37%; ~7 points copper pass-through, the rest volume, content and new programmes); Q1 x4 is already +19%. We assume Rs3,550 cr in each of Q2 and Q3 and ~Rs3,600 cr in Q4 (growth falls to ~8% in Q4 against a Rs3,335 cr base that already carried copper and the greenfields). FY28-29: PV production +6-8% a year (after the GST-cut year), content per vehicle +4-5% (features, EV/hybrid share 8.5% of revenue in Q1FY27, 1.5-1.7x the content of an ICE car per JM Financial), greenfields reaching ~Rs2,000 cr a year; copper held at Q1FY27 levels (no further pass-through inflation).

lineBuild._why: Company disclosure: FY26 revenue Rs11,478 cr = existing plants Rs10,438 cr + greenfields Rs1,040 cr (Q4FY26 presentation p10). Greenfields ran at ~Rs443-450 cr a quarter in Q4FY26-Q1FY27 and are sized for ~Rs2,000 cr a year (Q4FY26 call). Existing plants are the balance.

_marginWhy: FY26 9.2% (11.4% excluding Rs127 cr of greenfield start-up losses); Q1FY27 7.6%. FY27: Q1 7.6%, then ~8.5% for Q2-Q4 as the 3-6 month copper lag unwinds (management: majority of customers on a three-month reset) and the greenfields move above breakeven, but the NCR minimum-wage increase (35-40%) is recovered only partly and slowly ('nobody can predict exactly the timeline'). FY28-29: greenfields at parity with old plants and some wage recovery; we stay well below the 11-13% of FY22-25 because copper pass-through at cost permanently inflates revenue (denominator effect, as the CFO said) and royalty, management fee and support fees to the two partners take ~2.4% of revenue.
_capexWhy: Cash capex guided at ~Rs200 cr in FY27 (Q4FY26 call), funded internally; FY26 Rs201 cr. Management said in Aug-2026 that new expansion plans will follow 'in the next few quarters' as plants run at ~80%. We add ~Rs40 cr a year of new leased plant (right-of-use assets, most plants are leased from SAMIL) because the engine has no lease line, and lift capex to Rs270-280 cr in FY28-29 for the next round of plants.
_depWhy: FY26 depreciation Rs216 cr = 13.5% of average gross block (Rs1,604 cr), high because right-of-use (leased) buildings and harness tooling depreciate fast. Q1FY27 Rs60 cr.
_treasuryWhy: Applied by the engine to net cash only (borrowings include Rs223 cr of lease liabilities, so there is no treasury income until net cash turns positive). Bank deposit yield ~6%.
_otherIncomeWhy: Recurring items, not treasury: interest unwinding on security deposits with SAMIL and others (Rs2.7 cr in FY26, AR note 31), interest on deposits and small asset-sale gains. FY26 other income Rs3.9 cr (AR note 22; Rs12.8 cr in FY25 when cash was higher); Q1FY27 Rs5.4 cr. FY27E = Q1 plus ~Rs1.2 cr a quarter; Rs6 cr from FY28.
_interestWhy: Mostly interest on lease liabilities (Rs20.5 cr in FY26 incl. leases from SAMIL) plus working-capital lines: external debt rose from Rs10 cr (Mar-26) to Rs61 cr (Jun-26); Q1FY27 finance cost Rs8 cr.
_payoutWhy: Policy-like payout of ~62% of profit for FY26 (final Rs0.58 a share) and FY25; 59-65% since listing.

dcf._betaWhy: Tied to Indian car and truck production (cyclical) but net-debt-free with a 41% customer: beta 0.95, cost of equity 12.2%. Debt is only leases, so the cost of equity is the discount rate.
dcf._tgWhy: Indian vehicle production ~5-6% plus content growth; house range 5-6%: 6%.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~13% in FY29E to 8%.
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: EBITDA margin held at ~9.5%: no return to the 11-13% of FY22-25 while copper is at today's price.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Asset-light assembler: capex ~1.7-2% of revenue in FY24-26; depreciation 1.8-1.9% of revenue.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Car and SUV production keeps growing ~10% a year after the GST cut; customers agree to monthly copper resets and pay for the NCR wage increase; greenfields reach company margins by H2FY27; EV/hybrid share keeps rising; EBITDA margin back to ~10.5%.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: The GST-cut boost fades and PV production flattens; copper keeps rising so the lag never closes; wage increases spread to other states without compensation; Pune stays under-used; EBITDA margin stuck near 8%.

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values MSWIL: P/E on one-year-forward EPS (MOSL 35x FY28E, Emkay 30x Jun-28E, JM Financial 33x FY28E). Multiple derived in MSUMI.ctx.js (own forward P/E median since listing x auto-component de-rating) and written by MSUMI.val.js.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Own trailing EV/EBITDA median since listing with the same sector de-rating, restated to Sep-28E EBITDA.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Tests whether cash flows support the price: 15-year FCFF, cost of equity 12.2%, terminal growth 6%.
